subject: CareBridge access evidence export — SCIM delta, SAML samples, and owner matrix
messages:
From: Melissa Tanner <melissa.tanner@carebridge.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: trustops@carebridge.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Sean,

We're doing the SIG intake for CareBridge and the security team has a few follow-ups focused on provisioning and access controls. Specifically can you provide:

- A SCIM delta export (last 30 days) showing user lifecycle events, deprovisions, and attribute snapshots.
- SAML assertion samples for a few authentication flows (IDP-Initiated, SP-Initiated) including NameID and role attributes.
- A one-page owner matrix that maps application roles to Redwood owners and role owners.

We need this material for an upstream compliance review (SIG + CAIQ) — target due date is next Wednesday 2026-09-09. Can you confirm scope and whether you can deliver samples or a full export?

Thanks,
Melissa Tanner
Sr. IT Risk Manager
CareBridge Health

-----
Note: please share securely (SFTP or secured Drive link).
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Melissa Tanner <melissa.tanner@carebridge.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SIG/CAIQ

Melissa — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to get this over. Quick confirmation items so we scope correctly:

1) For the SCIM delta: do you want full attribute sets (emails, roles, manager, employeeId) for every event, or a stripped export (event + primary attributes) to reduce PII in transit?
2) For SAML samples: are you ok with redacted identifiers (hashed NameIDs) or do you need raw assertion strings for verification?
3) Owner matrix: we'll map Redwood service roles (admin, engineer, billing, support) to named owners; confirm if you want manager contact info included.

I'm looping in Irene (security/compliance) and Hannah (account lead) to own the artifact collection and delivery. We can deliver a secure Drive bundle and an evidence manifest by 2026-09-07 EOD if the stripped export is acceptable. Full raw exports may need an HMAC'd transfer and an extra day for approvals.

S
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SIG/CAIQ

Sean / Hannah — tagging Marcus for the SCIM extraction. Technical plan below:

Deliverables (target 2026-09-07 EOD):
- SCIM delta CSV (last 30 days) with columns: event_ts, event_type, user_id (hashed), primary_email, role_ids, manager_id (hashed), source (okta/google), change_summary. (carebridge_scim_delta_20260907.csv)
- SAML assertion samples (3 examples: IDP-init, SP-init, role-attribute present) with values redacted except for role claim names. (saml_assertion_samples_20260907.txt)
- Evidence manifest (xlsx) listing exports, extraction method, runbook steps, and chain-of-custody checksum. (evidence_manifest_cb_v1.xlsx)

Controls and privacy notes:
- We will hash principal identifiers with HMAC-SHA256 and include the salt separately under an encrypted key share (we can provide key material via our KMS transfer process if CareBridge requires it).
- Any raw assertion strings containing PII will be redacted; if CareBridge requires raw assertion bodies we will need a signed DPA amendment and an approved SFTP transfer.
- Least-privilege attestation: we will include a short narrative in the manifest describing RBAC mappings and the last role-review date. If you need per-user attestation we can add that as an add-on.

Marcus: please run the extraction against the provisioning audit logs and drop artifacts to the secure Drive path: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/secure/carebridge/SCIM-delta-20260907 .

Irene Choi
Head of Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: Melissa Tanner <melissa.tanner@carebridge.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: trustops@carebridge.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SIG/CAIQ

Thanks Sean / Irene — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- The review team would prefer hashed identifiers with the salt provided out-of-band, so your HMAC plan is fine.
- For SAML assertion samples: we only need the raw XML for the role claim and Subject fields; please redact any email addresses.
- For least-privilege proof: can you include the most recent role-owner attestation and any role-to-permission mapping artifacts you hold? A one-page narrative + matrix is ideal.

If you can drop by EOD today (2026-09-07) to the secure Drive link you suggested that will allow us to move forward with the SIG intake on Tuesday.

-Melissa

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Melissa Tanner <melissa.tanner@carebridge.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + SAML assertion samples for SIG/CAIQ

Melissa — uploaded the bundle to the secure Drive path and attached the evidence manifest. Link and checksums are in the manifest. Summary of what we delivered: 

- carebridge_scim_delta_20260907.csv (HMAC hashed user ids; primary attributes included)
- saml_assertion_samples_20260907.txt (raw XML with email redactions; role claims preserved)
- evidence_manifest_cb_v1.xlsx (deliverables index, extraction runbook, RBAC owner matrix, least-privilege attestation paragraph)

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want the HMAC salt delivered via our KMS transfer or via your SFTP endpoint. If you need raw, unredacted artifacts we will start the approval path (DPA amendment + infra transfer) which will add ~48 hours.

Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if your review team has questions.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: evidence_manifest_cb_v1.xlsx
